evidence: School is a per-row id: the page calls the table "the school-level demographic data to accompany the MathAchieve data", one row per school, and fits no model.

year is the fixed covariate of the documented clm(income ~ year, weights=pct); the rows are the income classes of one percentage distribution per year (McCullagh 1980), not units repeated within a year.
y1, y2, y3, y4 are the ordinal response "measured at 4 visits" as columns, one row per patient; the example reshapes to long and fits ordgee with id.
y1 to y4 are the seizure counts "in each of four two-week intervals" as columns, one row per individual; the examples reshape to long and fit geese with id.

year has two levels (Y1, Y2, the seasons 1929-1930 and 1930-1931), a design factor beside the fixed nitrogen, date, water and spacing factors; the rows are treatment means and no model on the page has a random effect.
field has two levels ("Field, F1 or F2"), a design factor; row and col are plot coordinates, each plot appears once and the page fits no model.
"The same land was used for 4 consecutive crops": each plot, row:col, repeats once per year, and year is a wave holding every plot.
"The plots were the same year-over-year": each plot, plot:range, repeats once in each of the years 1905 to 1908 that observed it (the page says three years).
1916 and 1918 used "one and the same" field (Cochran: two sets, 1916 and 1918), so each plot, row:col, repeats once per year.
One row per patient; state is a "grouped state of origin" (NSW includes ACT, other pools WA, SA, NT and TAS), a coarse classification, not a unit; the page fits no model.
One row per District x Group x Age cell; all three are fixed factors of the documented glm(Claims ~ District + Group + Age + offset(log(Holders)), family = poisson).
"data on 205 patients", one row each; time is survival time and year the year of operation, a covariate; no grouping column.
Prewt and Postwt are the patient's weight "before study period" and "after study period" as two columns, one row per patient.
"biopsies of breast tumours for 699 patients", one row each; ID is a "sample code number (not unique)" that the page never treats as a unit, and V1 to V9 and class are per-sample attributes.
Cult (two cultivars) and Date (three planting dates) are fixed design factors; no block, plot or other column indexes a unit.
Litter ("genotype of the litter") and Mother ("genotype of the foster mother") are fixed four-level genotype factors, not litter or mother ids.
pH, conductivity and chloride of each sampling location "at depths 0-10 cm, 30-40 cm and 80-90 cm" are columns (pH00, pH30, pH80, e00 to c80), one row per location.
One row per patient; ag is the binary test result of the documented coxph(Surv(time) ~ ag + log(wbc)); no grouping column.
temp is the fixed test temperature of survreg(Surv(time, cens) ~ temp); each motorette appears once and no column indexes it.
Children "classified by Culture, Age, Sex and Learner status", one row each; Days is the count response, no grouping column.
One row per fluid density; pm.y/pm.tot and kc.y/kc.tot are the two species' falling-out counts, two binomial responses side by side, not repeated measures of one unit.
One row per type x year x period cell of aggregate incidents and months of service (McCullagh and Nelder section 6.3.2); year is year of construction, a fixed factor.
Each Study row holds its two arms as columns (BCGTB/BCGVacc vaccinated, NoVaccTB/NoVacc not); the example reshapes them to long with study repeated.
"the data are stored in the wide form, i.e., repeated measurments are represented by additional columns": bdi.pre, bdi.2m, bdi.3m, bdi.5m, bdi.8m.
One row per child; group (row, corner) is a fixed two-level factor and time and EFT are two scores; no grouping column.
country ("the country the company is situated in") indexes a unit the companies repeat within; rank and name are per-row ids.
January, April, July and October are each city's lowest temperature in four months as columns, one row per city.
One row per patient ("31 male patients"); tumorsize is a fixed two-level factor and time a duration; no grouping column.
One row per patient; time is survival time, event its censoring and metastasized a fixed factor.
t0 to t5 are the phosphate level at baseline and after half an hour up to five hours as columns, one row per subject.
Each row is one student's estimate ("a group of 44 students" in metres, "another group of 69" in feet); unit is the fixed two-level factor.
school is "the school type" (F0 primary to F3 third form), an age group, not a school; children one row each, all four factors fixed.
A25.34 to A65.74 are each country's suicide rate in five age groups as columns, one row per country.
One row per participant; class (social class), age, gender, ethn and qual are fixed factors of the multinomial or binary logistic model.
"4,842 subjects", one row each; day is the day of the year of observation, a calendar covariate, not a unit.
The state-level table of Hodges (1998), one row per State; region is a state-level covariate, and the plans that repeat within state are in hodges, not here.
"we shall use data from time 5 only": one row per patient, so patient is a per-row id; treat is a fixed seven-level factor.
"316 men", one row each; Units counts transfused units and RBC.Age.Group is the exposure; no grouping column.

One row per patient; the attempt2 and attempt3 columns exist only after a failed attempt, not planned repeated measures, and the trial's outcomes (total_intubation_time, ease, intubation_overall_S_F) are per patient.
Cough and sore throat pain at extubation, at 30 and 90 minutes in PACU, at 4 hours and on the first postoperative morning are columns (extubation_cough to pod1am_throatPain), one row per patient.
baseline, number3m and number12m are the polyp number "measured (via colonoscopy) at baseline, 3 months, and 12 months" as columns, one row per participant_id.
"12 affected seamen", one row per study_id; treatment is a fixed six-level factor and the symptoms are day-6 ratings.
The S., SB. and Colon./C. columns hold the same contractions, sum of amplitudes, mean peak amplitude and mean pH for the stomach, small bowel and colon of one capsule passage, one row per subject.
subject is a per-row id ("Subject ID", "103 patients"); group is the randomized fixed treatment.
One row per verb ("285 monomorphemic Dutch verbs"); Aux and Regularity are fixed verb attributes of kruskal.test(VerbalSynsets, Aux).
Metadata, one row per Speaker; Sex, AgeGroup, ConversationType and EduLevel are speaker attributes; no response or model.
One row per Verb; the documented lrm models of Regularity and of EtymAge have fixed predictors only.
One row per Word ("1697 Dutch monomorphemic words"); the documented lrm(Voice ~ ...) has fixed phonological predictors only.
Points reconstructed from a figure; Condition is the fixed two-level factor of lm(FilteredSignal ~ BehavioralScore*Condition), and no column identifies a patient.
A lookup table, one row per lexical measure (Variable) with its Class (Form or Meaning) and gloss; no response or model.
A frequency table of tag-trigram categories (columns) per text (rows) for correspondence analysis; the columns are the categories of one cross-tabulation, not one measure repeated over a design.
One row per Language; Family is a two-level classification and the other columns are distinct binary grammatical traits for neighbour-joining trees.
One row per Word, ratings "averaged over subjects"; the documented lm(meanSizeRating ~ meanFamiliarity * Class + I(meanFamiliarity^2)) has fixed effects only.
One row per Verb; the documented lrm(Regularity ~ ...) has fixed predictors only.
The eight columns count -lijk for the same word in each region x sex x education cell (nlfemaleHigh to vlmaleMid), one row per word, so the long form repeats word across the cells.
group (ctrl, trt1, trt2) is the fixed treatment of anova(lm(weight ~ group)); no column indexes a unit.
"Daily readings" from May 1 to September 30, 1973, one row per day, a single time series; Month and Day are calendar indices, not units.
One row per department, "aggregated from the questionnaires" of its employees; the documented lm(rating ~ .) has no grouping.
Individual ID is the page's "unique ID for each individual in dataset" and Date Egg the date a study nest was observed; Species and Island are fixed classifications and no model has a random effect.
"1000 seismic events", one row per event; lat, long, depth, mag and stations are event attributes, no grouping column.
